cohort: The study included 69 singleton pregnancies with gestational diabetes (GDM) and 128 healthy singleton pregnancies as controls.
finding: GDM women exhibited significant maternal hemodynamic maladaptations during pregnancy, characterized by lower cardiac output, stroke volume, cardiac index, and inotropy index, and higher total vascular resistance and potential to kinetic energy ratio compared to healthy controls.
cross-section timing: Observations were taken at 17-20 weeks, 26-30 weeks, 32-35 weeks, and 36-39 weeks gestational age.
